_README: Custom function tool, in the shape documented on Bolna's 'custom function schema' page. Render the placeholders with scripts/render_bolna_files.py, then add it to the agent in the dashboard (Tools tab). How to attach it through the API is not documented on the pages we read, so the dashboard is the safe route. Ticket #11 is exactly the test that proves it fires mid-call.
name: submit_quote
description: Call this immediately after the supplier has said a price for ONE item and you have repeated it back and they have confirmed it. Call it once per item. Never call it with a guessed price.

call_ref.description: The call reference given in your instructions. Always pass it exactly as given.

item.description: The item name in English, for example onions or oil.

unit_price.description: The price exactly as the supplier said it, for example 'pachchis rupaye' or '25'.

unit.description: The unit the price is per, for example kg, quintal or litre.

available.description: Whether the supplier has the full requested quantity.

delivery_time.description: When they can deliver, for example 07:00.

credit_days.description: Days of credit they offer. 0 if none.

delivery_fee.description: Delivery charge in rupees. 0 if none.

what_they_said.description: The supplier's own words about this price.
